stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Can the laptop do my round?

stations.title: Handwritten list
stations.text: Wind clock 1, wind clock 2, all by hand.

captions: Kasimir starts every morning with the same round, and wants the laptop to do it.
Today he writes the list by hand, a line for every clock, every day.
You repeat the steps with for and while loops, in four tasks.
Now the round prints itself, however many clocks the morning brings.
The program can repeat now. Next, Ambrose wants his sums written once.
